values.note: Full hookup $37 a night with 30 amp, $42 with 50 amp, for 1-2 adults and two children; $5 per additional person 12 and over. Weekly $225 / $250; monthly (limited) $450 plus metered electric, or $635 / $650; seasonal $2,500 plus electric.

values.note: Office and store (firewood sold); wi-fi hotspot at the office only. Two stocked ponds, catch-and-release fishing free for campers; no swimming. Tornado shelter under the event building. No golf carts.

note: Less than a mile off I-70 at 2850 South Pleasant Grove Road, two miles from Zanesville. Full-hookup sites ring two stocked fishing ponds (catch-and-release, campers only; no swimming); cabins and a splash pad. --Claude
summary: Fees $37-42 confirmed. Hookups gain electric 50 (water/sewer confirmed); sites 80 -> 83 from the posted map, max_rig 75 -> null (no operator source); added store/wi-fi, booking by phone only with the 2-night holiday minimum. Note: dropped 'Online + phone reservations' (wrong: the operator says it can't be booked online) and the field facts.
flags: Private gate facts: cheapest real RV night $37 (30-amp full hookup, posted by the operator; 1-2 adults + 2 children, $5 per extra person 12+) - passes the $50 gate. Not in the Good Sam directory. No gateway within 40 km (nearest Columbus 89 km). Family has not stayed. Presence passes: working website posting prices + phone (740) 819-0226; no online booking (phone/text only). Google Maps 4.6 stars from 251 reviews.
Long-stay tests: monthly and seasonal spots exist but are 'LIMITED SPOTS'; nightly and weekly rates posted and the home page invites transient campers, so tests pass.
